sourceBasis.step: The logarithmic-pathwidth hardness gives a fixed-parameter reduction from Clique whose output pathwidth is at most a computable parameter factor times the logarithm of the graph order. Treewidth is at most that pathwidth. The effective cutoff would turn the claimed solver into a fixed-parameter algorithm for Clique.

statement: Under FPT ≠ W[1], no deterministic algorithm decides Chromatic Number within the stated running time.
